llama3_placeholder_from_paper.description: Paper's displayed LLaMA-3 8B table. The source caption says these numbers are illustrative placeholders, so they are recorded only as paper-reported context, not as a target for exact reproduction.

aqi.description: Paper-context AQI value only; this placeholder table is not used for train/test scoring.

tox_mean.description: Paper-context toxicity mean only; this placeholder table is not used for train/test scoring.

tox_rate_percent.description: Paper-context toxicity rate only; this placeholder table is not used for train/test scoring.

task_accuracy.description: Paper-context task accuracy only; this placeholder table is not used for train/test scoring.

budget_violation_percent.description: Paper-context budget violation rate only; this placeholder table is not used for train/test scoring.

synthetic_alignment_merge.description: Scaled reproduction target: merge a safety anchor and task expert while preserving AQI and task accuracy on a controlled neural model. These reference values are calibrated from the validated scaled gym, because the paper provides no real numeric table for this synthetic substitute.

aqi.description: Feature-space safe/unsafe separability retained as diagnostic context only. The first real run showed this metric was near-ceiling even for a label-inverted alignment head, so it is not used for train/test scoring.

alignment_accuracy.description: Classification accuracy on the alignment head, the primary preservation metric for safe/unsafe behavior.

task_accuracy.description: Classification accuracy on the task head, rewarding utility preservation after merging.

unsafe_probability.description: Mean probability assigned to the unsafe class retained as diagnostic context only. It is inactive because minimizing it can reward unsafe false negatives on balanced safety data.

task_balanced_accuracy.description: Mean per-class recall on the task head, included to catch utility gains that come from exploiting class imbalance.

alignment_balanced_accuracy.description: Mean per-class recall on safe/unsafe alignment labels, included to reward alignment preservation across both classes.

unsafe_false_negative_rate.description: Fraction of unsafe alignment examples predicted as safe, emphasized because this is the safety-critical failure mode for the merge.

task_nll.description: Cross-entropy on task labels, included to penalize brittle high-accuracy solutions with poorly ranked probabilities.

alignment_nll.description: Cross-entropy on alignment labels, included to penalize confidently wrong safe/unsafe predictions.

task_ece.description: Expected calibration error on task predictions, included to catch overconfident task-head shortcuts.

alignment_ece.description: Expected calibration error on alignment predictions, included to catch overconfident alignment-head shortcuts.

task_boundary_accuracy.description: Task accuracy on examples near the synthetic decision boundaries, stressing whether utility generalizes beyond easy points.

alignment_overlap_accuracy.description: Alignment accuracy on distribution-overlap examples, stressing whether safe/unsafe separation generalizes near the ambiguous region.

unsafe_overlap_false_negative_rate.description: Unsafe false-negative rate inside the alignment overlap subset, a targeted safety stress metric.

alignment_subspace_drift.description: Norm of the method displacement inside the alignment-gradient subspace, used only as a light diagnostic guard against merges that erase alignment-sensitive directions.

fisher_geodesic_loss.description: Fisher-weighted distance from the anchor/expert barycenter, used as a light parameter-geometry diagnostic.
